rule: A card existing in two zones at once -> duplication/loss bugs. Enforce 'exactly one zone'; move = remove-then-add, and assert no card appears twice.

probe.expression: (() => { startStage(0); const gridIds = state.grid.flat().filter(c => c && c.cardId).map(c => c.cardId); const all = [...state.hand, ...state.aiPool, ...gridIds]; return all.length === 11 && new Set(all).size === 11 && state.hand.length === 5 && state.aiPool.length === 5 && gridIds.length === 1; })()

remediation: Keep single-zone partition invariant across state.hand, state.aiPool, and state.grid.

rule: Off-by-one in the shuffle's random index -> some orders never occur (a biased deck). Include upper bound i in Fisher-Yates.
remediation: Use inclusive upper bound (i + 1) in Fisher-Yates shuffle.

rule: Card data — id, name, cost, type, text, and an effect spec (data, not code).

probe.expression: (() => { const cards = Object.values(ALL_CARDS); return cards.length === 16 && cards.every(c => c.id && c.name && Array.isArray(c.nesw) && c.nesw.length === 4 && c.nesw.every(v => v >= 1 && v <= 9) && c.telegraphType && c.telegraphName && c.art); })()

remediation: Ensure all 16 cards in ALL_CARDS define structured NESW and telegraph data fields.

rule: Turn structure as a phase machine — Fixed phases keep timing windows (triggers, priority) unambiguous.
remediation: Store the timer ID from `state.bossTurnTimer = setTimeout(executeBossTurn, 650)` at line 1754 and call `clearTimeout(state.bossTurnTimer)` inside `startStage(idx)` at line 1546 so Reset/Stage-Select never leaks a stale boss turn onto the new board (Bug R01).

rule: Targeting state leaks -> a cancelled play leaves the board mid-targeting. Make play atomic: validate cost + targets first, then commit.
remediation: Call `detachDragListeners(); teardownDrag();` inside `startStage(idx)` at line 1546, and re-validate `state.isPlayerTurn && srcCell.owner === 'player'` inside `onDragPointerUp()` at line 2366 before committing a drop or Tactical Slide (Bugs R03, R04).

rule: Effect resolution — apply a card's effects in a defined order; handle targets and triggers consistently across all board units.

probe.expression: (() => { startStage(2); state.colDice = [6, 2, 2]; state.grid[0][1] = { r: 0, c: 1, cardId: 'e_titan', owner: 'player', nesw: getCardEffectiveStats('e_titan', 1, true), justFlipped: false }; recalcBoardStats(); const preservedAiBonus = state.grid[0][1].nesw[0] === 8; startStage(0); return preservedAiBonus; })()

remediation: Fix `recalcBoardStats()` at line 1614 so captured cards preserve their base/stage `aiBonus` and AI-owned cards in boosted columns also recalculate cleanly when column dice change (Bug R07).

rule: Unseeded shuffle in a game that needs replays/undo -> can't reproduce. Use a seeded RNG instance (not the engine's global one).
remediation: Replace raw `Math.random()` in `shuffle()`, `rerollAllDice()`, and `executeBossTurn()` with a deterministic seeded PRNG (`mulberry32(state.seed)`) synced with URL `?seed=`.

rule: Store trauma 0..1; shake = trauma^2 so small hits barely move, big hits punch. Smooth pseudo-random via sampled noise/sin, NOT rand each frame.
remediation: Drive screen shake from decaying quadratic `trauma * trauma` and smooth sine waves.

rule: Hit-stop with WaitForSecondsRealtime ignores Time.timeScale, so the timer still elapses. Let only the newest call restore it.
remediation: Use WaitForSecondsRealtime and an incrementing hit-stop token in Unity C#.

rule: (1) Exaggerate briefly and return to rest; (2) scale juice to event importance — a routine placement is not a multi-card capture.

probe.expression: (() => { const code = handleSlotClick.toString(); return code.includes('triggerHitStop(80)') && code.includes('0.38 + flips.length * 0.2') && code.includes('addTrauma(0.18)'); })()

remediation: Scale trauma with capture count and reserve 80ms hit-stop for captures.

rule: Over-juicing routine actions causes nausea and hides real impacts. Scale to importance; add a 'reduce screen shake'/'reduce flashing' accessibility option.
remediation: Respect `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches` and provide a UI toggle to suppress `addTrauma()` and brightness-flash hit-stop filters.

rule: Pick a layout model: anchors + containers, never absolute pixels. Scale to fit with zero viewport clipping.

probe.expression: (() => { const mainStyle = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('main')); const noOverflow = document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth && document.documentElement.scrollHeight <= window.innerHeight; return mainStyle.display === 'grid' && noOverflow; })()

remediation: Use CSS Grid containers and `clamp()` viewport-relative sizing so 1408x800 and 1280x800 never overflow.

rule: Make every screen keyboard/gamepad navigable. Set an initial focused control per screen, define focus order/neighbors.
remediation: Initialize `state.focusedSlotIndex = 4` (center tile) and support keyboard navigation.

rule: Model screens as a stack. Push (pause/modal over game), pop (resume/reset), with input + visibility handed to the top screen.
remediation: In `startStage(idx)` at line 1546, explicitly pop/hide `#result-modal` (`document.getElementById('result-modal').style.display = 'none'`), auto-focus the primary modal button on open, and hide/disable `Next Stage ▶` when `win === false` (Bugs R08, R09).

rule: Tiny fixed font sizes are unreadable on a TV-at-distance or small phone. Scale text with the UI (Xbox Accessibility Guideline 101 floor).
remediation: Raise minimum UI badge/pill typography from `9.5px`/`10px` to `clamp(12px, 1.1vw, 14px)` and add non-color owner icons alongside blue/red borders for deuteranopia accessibility.

rule: Technical fit: exact size/frame count, usable alpha, stable anchors/pivots, correct color space/filtering, no clipped content.

probe.expression: (() => { const imgs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slot-art')); return imgs.length >= 6 && imgs.every(img => img.complete && img.naturalWidth === 600 && img.naturalHeight === 800); })()

remediation: Maintain 600x800 (3:4 portrait) mastered card art across all 16 hero and mech units.

rule: UI art or icons: Keep text and interaction code-native; prefer SVG/vector for simple geometric symbols.

probe.expression: (() => { const ids = Object.keys(ALL_CARDS); return ids.length === 16 && ids.every(id => buildUniqueTelegraphSVG(ALL_CARDS[id]).includes('<svg')); })()

remediation: Keep all 16 card telegraph overlays as crisp inline SVG vector animations.

rule: Define the class deriving from ScriptableObject and tag it with [CreateAssetMenu]; keep mutable runtime state in [NonSerialized] fields reset in OnEnable.
remediation: Derive shared variable/card config classes from ScriptableObject with [CreateAssetMenu] and [NonSerialized] runtime state.

rule: Disabled Domain Reload skips your OnEnable reset — also reset on EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged or [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)].
remediation: Subscribe `EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged` inside `#if UNITY_EDITOR` on `ScriptableObjectDomainReloadGuard` so fast Play Mode entry without Domain Reload still resets `RuntimeValue`.

rule: Define actions, not raw keys; guard global key handlers when native form/select controls hold focus and expose all gameplay actions to keyboard.

probe.expression: (() => { const code = handleHarnessKeyDown.toString(); return (code.includes('SELECT') || code.includes('tagName')) && code.includes('nudgeColDie'); })()

remediation: In `handleHarnessKeyDown(e)` at line 1410, ignore key events when `['SELECT','BUTTON','INPUT'].includes(e.target.tagName)` (Bug R10) and bind keys (e.g. `q`/`e`/`z` or `Alt+1..3`) to `nudgeColDie(0..2)`.

rule: Lay out buses, not per-sound volume (Master <- {Music, SFX, UI}) and operate in decibels with SFX pitch variation.

probe.expression: (() => { const code = playTone.toString(); return code.includes('masterGain') || code.includes('sfxBus') || code.includes('muted'); })()

remediation: Route `playTone()` through a persistent `masterGain` / `sfxBus` GainNode with dB-to-linear conversion (`Math.pow(10, db / 20)`), subtle pitch jitter (`±0.5` semitones), and a header Mute button.

rule: Define a versioned schema (`version` integer) and persist player progress/settings across sessions.
remediation: Persist unlocked/cleared stages, best stage scores, camera preset, and audio mute state to `localStorage` under a versioned JSON schema (`{ version: 1, clearedStages: [...], bestScores: {...} }`).

rule: Pick the decision model by complexity: utility scoring evaluates candidate options across offensive capture and positional defense rather than random tie-breaking.

probe.expression: (() => { const code = executeBossTurn.toString(); return code.includes('exposedEdges') || code.includes('utilityScore') || code.includes('tieBreak'); })()

remediation: Upgrade `executeBossTurn()` at line 1773 from single-card `aiPool.pop()` + random tie-break (`f > bestCount`) to a deterministic utility scorer that weights immediate captures, corner control, and unexposed weak edges (Bug R02).

rule: Define the target and reproduce: 60 FPS = 16.67 ms/frame budget; zero long tasks (>50ms) during pointer drag and hover sweeps.

probe.fallback_expression: (() => { const t0 = performance.now(); renderAll(); return +(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2); })()

remediation: Keep `renderAll()` under 1 ms and freeze board parallax during active pointer drag so 60 Hz frame pacing holds at `p95 <= 16.8ms`.
